title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-prep-2026-03-09-evan
content:
Goal: Quick, focused sync to unblock launch prep for KV cache fixes + console rollout. Keep to 45 minutes.

Context / current focus:
- Infra: KV cache regression causing ~15% p99 increase on 8k seqs (seen in perf-run-2026-03-02). Investigating root cause after quantization patch.
- Serving runtime: kernel selector changes staged in canary; need metrics confirmation before full rollout.
- Console: rollout plan for per-route latency dashboards, dependency on new tracing hooks.

Agenda (45m):
1) Quick rundowns (10m) - 2m each: Priya (infra), Maya (runtime), Liam (console), Evan (ops items)
2) KV cache regression update (10m) - Priya
   - Short summary of investigation so far
   - Hypothesis: quantized attention kernel interaction with KV eviction timing
   - Telemetry we need from canary to confirm (token-level timings, eviction counts)
3) Kernel selector canary metrics (8m) - Maya
   - Current canary perf vs baseline (p50,p95,p99, throughput)
   - Any tail regressions observed?
4) Console rollout blockers (7m) - Liam
   - Tracing hooks integration status, ETA for patch
   - Dashboard templates for per-route breakdown ready? (need review)
5) Action items & owners (5m)
6) Parking / async follow-ups (5m)

Pre-meeting asks (please update before start):
- Priya: paste latest perf dashboard link + key logs (INFRA-842)
- Maya: short snippet of canary vs baseline numbers in the doc
- Liam: share draft dashboard screenshots and access link

Notes / bullets to capture during meeting:
- Priya to confirm whether reproducer exists on small repro run (yes/no)
- If reproducer exists, get minimal repro + perf profile attached to INFRA-842
- Maya to run kernel-selector A/B for 24h and report p99 delta, capture CPU/GPU utilization
- Liam to add the tracing hook PR to review board and tag infra/runtime for integration testing

Action items (tracked):
- ACTION-1: Priya Patel — Add perf dashboard link and attach KV cache logs to INFRA-842. due: 2026-03-11. status: todo.
- ACTION-2: Maya Singh — Run 24h A/B canary on kernel selector and paste summary numbers here. due: 2026-03-12. status: todo.
- ACTION-3: Liam O'Connell — Create console dashboard draft + invite reviewers (Maya + Priya). due: 2026-03-10. status: todo.
- ACTION-4: Evan Chen — Coordinate an async triage session if reproducer found; schedule 60m deep-dive. due: 2026-03-13. status: todo.

Parking list / follow-ups (async):
- Verify whether cache eviction policy needs change vs kernel fix (design doc needed)
- Post-rollout smoke checklist for per-route latency dashboards
- Consider adding an automated alert for sudden p99 shifts on 4k+ seqs

Quick links:
- perf-run-2026-03-02 dashboard: https://dash.company.internal/r/perf-run-2026-03-02
- INFRA-842: https://jira.company/browse/INFRA-842
- Kernel selector PR: https://github.com/redwood/serving-runtime/pull/1420

Personal notes / prep for me (Evan):
- Bring up capacity to hold a 60m emergency triage Wed afternoon if reproducer confirmed
- Check on Dedicated queue quotas in case we need to spin up repro infra
- Remind Maya to include GPU utilization buckets in A/B report

Next meeting goal: confirm root cause or have a reproducible repro + short remediation plan.
